picks.name: Oceanic
picks.bio: Rotterdam label Nous'klaer Audio's own Svebbe Oceanic. "ICI" (August 14, 2026) is a four-track 12" -- ICI, Capyra Vision, Tassman Perks, Prefig -- balancing two propulsive club cuts against two more immersive groove-builders.
picks.why_listen: Direct, driving Rotterdam-style techno/electro from the label's own camp -- solid peak-time material with a couple of deeper detours to breathe between the harder cuts.

picks.name: Groove Armada
picks.source_note: New release on Shall Not Fade.
picks.bio: The veteran UK dance duo turn up on Shall Not Fade. "Body Action" (August 21, 2026) is a three-track EP -- Body Action, Gangsta Girl, U Found Love (ft Give Love) -- built as jacking, stripped-back house for the dancefloor, with the title track a heads-down 808 workout.
picks.why_listen: A big-name crossover act working in a leaner, more functional register than their festival-stage material -- straightforward jacking house tools that mix cleanly.

picks.name: Palms Trax
picks.source_note: Already seeded (Dekmantel-adjacent); first solo material in five years.
picks.bio: Berlin-based British producer, already in your seeds. "Keys To A Printed Garden" (August 21, 2026) is a two-track EP on fabric Originals -- lead single "Soft Trance, Hard Gossip" and the title track -- his first solo release since 2021.
picks.why_listen: A genuine comeback: warm deep-house grooves, hazy nu-groove textures and acid basslines from an artist who's been quiet for half a decade -- worth flagging even outside your usual label-watch list.
